en.title: Coalition committee ends after four hours
en.summary: A coalition committee meeting concluded after four hours of discussion.

en.title: Execution attempt in Tennessee: American woman able to speak again after surviving execution
en.summary: Christa Pike is conscious following her failed execution attempt and her lawyers report she is angry and confused. They are demanding that no further execution attempt be made.

en.title: Live blog Iran war: Saudi Arabia reports major attack on Houthi militia targets
en.summary: Saudi Arabia launched strikes against Houthi positions while the militia attacked airports with rockets. Three people died in attacks on Saudi airports, and Turkey and Pakistan deployed troops.

en.title: After failed execution: Lawyers discuss Pike's health status
en.summary: Convicted murderer Christa Pike survived two lethal injections during an execution attempt in the USA. Separately, a man was executed in Texas.

en.title: USA news blog: Democrats sue Trump over campaign financing
en.summary: Democrats filed a lawsuit against Trump, accusing him of using taxpayer money for campaign activities presented as anti-communist messaging before midterm elections.

en.title: Ukraine reports 28 dead in Russian attacks on Putin's birthday
en.summary: Russia launched a major wave of attacks on Ukraine coinciding with Vladimir Putin's 74th birthday, including strikes on a five-story residential building that resulted in deaths.

en.title: US Democrats sue Trump over campaign advertising funded by taxpayer money
en.summary: Democrats filed a lawsuit against Donald Trump over campaign advertisements for midterm elections that allegedly use government funds and are marked as government-financed.

en.summary: The Iran-backed Houthi militia intensified attacks on targets in Saudi Arabia as part of the escalating Yemen conflict, with three people killed in airport strikes.

en.summary: Microsoft is equipping its Surface laptops with new Nvidia chips designed to run demanding AI calculations locally. The devices are competitively priced at their announced price points.

en.summary: The SEC has cautioned Blackrock, Vanguard, and State Street that their status as passive investors could be jeopardized. The warning followed their interactions with a climate advocacy group.

en.title: Column "Asia Techonomics": Singapore's government now competes with Tinder
en.summary: Singapore is launching a state-operated dating application aimed at increasing the city-state's birth rate. The column examines whether other countries might learn lessons from this approach by the Southeast Asian nation.

en.summary: Foreign policy expert Liana Fix discusses Germany's military buildup and rising influence of the AfD party, outlining how Europe can protect itself against antidemocratic misuse of German military power.
